title.zh-TW: 還清短期借款並支付利息
title.en: Repay all short-term borrowings with interest

summary.zh-TW: 以現金還清短期借款本金 {{money:derived.principal}}，並支付利息 {{money:param.interest}}。
summary.en: Repay short-term borrowings of {{money:derived.principal}} in cash and pay interest of {{money:param.interest}}.

label.zh-TW: 要還的本金（帳上短期借款餘額）

message.zh-TW: 帳上沒有短期借款可以還。
message.en: There are no short-term borrowings to repay.

message.zh-TW: 現金不夠同時還本金和付利息。
message.en: There is not enough cash to repay the principal and pay the interest.

explanation.zh-TW: 同一次付款拆成兩條現金行：還本金屬於籌資活動，出現在短期借款返還；付利息在教材的間接法裡屬於營業活動，出現在支付之利息。損益表上的{{term:tm_k6t2e9wr}}會在小計之前先加回，所以利息不會被扣兩次。
explanation.en: One payment is split into two cash lines. Repaying the principal is a financing activity and appears as repayment of short-term borrowings. In the course's indirect method, paying interest is an operating activity and appears as interest paid. The {{term:tm_k6t2e9wr}} on the income statement is added back before the subtotal, so the interest is not deducted twice.
